Do not edit shared indexes, prior files, stage, commit, publish or spawn agents. Parent owns integration. Avoid writing into sealed dependencies even when reproducing prior verifiers.

History/significance standard: R011 is accepted for a genuine missing operation, not merely a new formulation. Read its final significance review and the final I36 significance review. I14 spectral width, I15 topology, I17 Ramsey, I30 Einstein metric stability, I36 common geometric avoidance all have proof PASS but TECHNICAL ONLY because existing proof operations supply the bridge. I30's refined square-root volume budget is exactly Clarke's classical subset Ebin lemma. I36's common physical windows and logparameter partition follow KP2025 plus G/D routing. An unstated theorem with a complete proof can still be technical. Do not impose a preselected negative verdict: seek a substantive genuinely unpaid mechanism.
I35 transport parked: transverse redistribution estimate is equivalent to uniform Gibbs bias, no arbitrary-target density-robust cube-root result. I37 completed gap report: 2^-n² avoidance C open; scoped obstruction only to fair-selector completion-independent signature method; digital-cover and conditional-survivor criteria unpaid. No need to pursue either. I31 nonconical algebra may still be live; do not duplicate. I29 commonbase entropy technical. Read relevant historical screens before selecting candidate.

BROAD DISCOVERY:
Screen at least THREE genuinely distinct sharp inequality/stability candidates among (or justified alternatives to) catalogue087 Mahler/functional Mahler;091 log/Lp Brunn-Minkowski/B;096 Gaussian propeller;262 finite-matrix Lieb-Thirring;354 cubic-three-torus isoperimetric profile. These are seeds, not verified theorem statements: identify actual manuscript paths and proof/equality/remainder interfaces. Search all prior project work to avoid repetition. Early current primary-literature search (browse required) and full strongest-relevant proof comparison must reject already-proved quantitative remainders, calibration transfers, or routine compactness/Morse corollaries before deep work.
For each give exact target quantifiers, normalized class, deficit, distance and quotient by symmetries; specify dimension/rank/parameter dependence, degenerations, endpoint/equality branches. Do NOT infer uniform rate or power law from equality classification or compactness; do not import uniform Hessian coercivity without proof. If source already supplies coercivity/remainder, applying it is technical unless another real bridge is needed.
Promising choices could connect sharp source equality structure to robust classification under weak topology, branch transitions, rank-uniform stability, functional/geometric transfer with a missing uniform estimate, or admissible perturbation obstructions; you choose based on actual source and prior-art evidence.

DEEP WORK:
Choose strongest nontrivial candidate; attempt complete stand-alone proof with new operation. Attack delicate estimates with adversarial scaling/degeneration examples and exact/certified tests where useful. If main route fails, develop at least one substantively different mechanism. A meaningful counterexample to a proposed generalization is welcome; failure of a sufficient estimate is NOT a counterexample to the target. Do not stop at a list of open problems.
If complete, exact theorem/proof/constants/dependency graph and bounded novelty limits; no worldwide-priority or substantial acceptance claim (fresh independent proof/significance reviews will follow). If none closes, deeply developed honest gap report, rigorous partial deductions, exact unproved lemma, reason each candidate was rejected. Do not relax gate to manufacture sixth result.

EVIDENCE:
Freeze this full brief and relevant original briefs/objections; selected source Git identities and raw pinned URLs, theorem labels, passages actually read, full current primary requests/responses/versions and failures, complete inventory/search audit. Retain exact scripts/data for meaningful validation; numerical checks never proof. Provide artifact seal and runnable verifier; distinguish mutable shared-ledger drift from immutable proof dependency drift. Keep downloaded caches subject to project ignore policy. Return concise disposition and exact commands. No shared files or commits.
